title: Web Manga 'Real mo Tama ni wa Uso wo Tsuku' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Manga author Niichi announced on their official X account on Sunday that their Real mo Tama ni wa Uso wo Tsuku ( Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie! ) web manga is receiving a television anime adaptation. Niichi drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement (pictured). The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie Gets Anime Adaptation
content: Sometimes Even Reality Is a Lie manga series by Niichi is getting an anime adaptation, set to release in 2027. Two commemorative illustrations by the manga creator were also released: The manga was originally serialized on Niichi’s X (formerly Twitter) account since 2018.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ghost Mikawa's Mercenary Sisters Novel Gets Manga Adaptation
content: Kadokawa 's Comic Newtype online manga magazine announced on July 16 that manga artist Ka Sakana (name romanization not confirmed) will launch the manga adaptation of Ghost Mikawa 's Mercenary Sisters ( Shimai Yōhei ) novel on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Bleach Mirrors High Mobile Game's Trailer Reveals 3 New Characters
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment unveiled an overview trailer for the Bleach Mirrors High mobile game on Saturday. The trailer reveals characters Maiko Tokishima, Giro Hando, and Naru Jurinna. The video also showcases card-based battles as well as avatar and Zanpakuto customization.
author: ANN

title: 3 Things to Know Before Solo Leveling’s Upcoming Movie
content: After making fans wait for more than a year, A-1 Pictures confirmed a Solo Leveling film, which will continue Jinwoo’s journey. The anime has already wrapped up the Jeju Island Arc, but the story is far from over. Jinwoo has yet to solve the mystery behind the system and the appearance of the Gates.
author: ComicBook

title: The Greatest Mind-Bending Anime Is Streaming For Free
content: The Summer 2026 anime season is finally here, and fans are all set to welcome the new films and shows of the season. While Crunchyroll again steals the spotlight for streaming a majority of the new anime shows, other services also have a range of surprises planned for fans.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach’s Return Is Closer Than Ever With a Major Shonen Jump Series Ending
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has serialized some of the best manga series of all time. This doesn’t just include classics such as Dragon Ball Z and One Piece , but also new-generation series such as Jujutsu Kaisen and Demon Slayer .
author: ComicBook

title: Flower and Asura Manga Ends in August
content: The August issue of Shueisha 's Ultra Jump magazine announced on Friday that writer Ayano Takeda and artist Musshu will end their Flower and Asura ( Hana wa Saku, Shura no Gotoku ) manga in the magazine's next issue on August 19.
author: ANN
